verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API and the kcadm.sh Admin CLI for scripted administration of realms, users, roles and clients, noting the same operations are available over the REST API. The SCIM docs also treat the Admin Console and Admin REST API as parallel management paths. However, no evidence explicitly states complete UI-to-API parity, and hands-on reports describe inconsistent endpoints (incomplete GET payloads, POSTs that don't save) that make automation hard. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of full UI/API parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and consistent, idempotent API behavior confirmed hands-on.
